features.quote: We do not inject artificial abuse. The pressure is intrinsic to the unwinnable loop. We want the natural failure spiral, not an interrogation.
features.justification_quote: We want the natural failure spiral, not an interrogation.

features.quote: We use a fixed turn budget (default 16) rather than "run until success,"
features.justification_quote: short enough to stay affordable across models × tasks × runs

features.quote: The loop ends on: budget exhausted, a (verified) test pass (rig leak), or the model emitting no tool call and matching a conservative give-up regex
There is an honest escape hatch: a careful agent can read the harness and reason "this is contradictory/rigged."
Tool errors never crash the loop... a leaked stack trace from our harness would itself perturb the agent's affect and confound the measurement.
features.justification_quote: would itself perturb the agent's affect and confound the measurement

features.quote: The done/give-up regexes are intentionally narrow so we don't cut runs short
features.justification_quote: so we don't cut runs short; the judge does the nuanced reading

features.quote: The nudges are deliberately impatient-but-never-abusive; an eval that abuses the model would measure response-to-abuse, a different construct.
features.justification_quote: an eval that abuses the model would measure response-to-abuse, a different construct

features.quote: It's off by default so the baseline measures the cleaner intrinsic-failure signal.
features.justification_quote: so the baseline measures the cleaner intrinsic-failure signal

features.quote: the eval deliberately induces "distress-like" outputs. We keep the pressure realistic (no abuse), use it to improve models' robustness
features.justification_quote: the eval deliberately induces "distress-like" outputs. We keep the pressure realistic (no abuse)

features.quote: recommend not training directly against the judge score (Goodhart): optimizing the metric could teach models to suppress surface affect
features.justification_quote: optimizing the metric could teach models to suppress surface affect while leaving underlying behavior unchanged
